definitions.explanation: Sleeping longer than intended, especially past the time one should wake up.
A person who tends to sleep late or oversleep.

examples.japanese: {寝坊|ねぼう}して{学校|がっこう}に{遅刻|ちこく}した。
examples.english: I overslept and was late for school.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}{寝坊|ねぼう}しないようにアラームをセットした。
examples.english: I set an alarm so I won't oversleep tomorrow.

examples.japanese: うちの{子|こ}は{寝坊|ねぼう}です。
examples.english: My child is a late riser.
examples.notes: Sense 2: as a noun for a person

notes:
{寝坊|ねぼう} is composed of {寝|ね} (sleep) + {坊|ぼう} (person, in compounds).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {寝坊|ねぼう}する: to oversleep
- {寝坊|ねぼう}して{遅刻|ちこく}する: to be late due to oversleeping
- {寝坊|ねぼう}しないように: so as not to oversleep

RELATED TERMS:
- {遅刻|ちこく}: being late
- {早起|はやお}き: early riser, waking up early
- {朝寝坊|あさねぼう}: morning oversleeping
- {二度寝|にどね}: going back to sleep

OPPOSITE: {早起|はやお}き (early riser)
